items.summary: Create a new page at '/feed' (or '/all') that displays all PDFs uploaded by all users/accounts in a single, publicly accessible feed. Each entry should show the PDF title, uploader's principal (truncated for readability), upload date, and an 'Open' button that navigates to the existing viewer at /view/<shareId>. The page must be accessible without authentication, using the existing anonymous-compatible listPdfs() backend call. Sort entries by upload timestamp descending (newest first).

Add a 'Feed' navigation link in the site header (Header.tsx) that routes to the new all-PDFs feed page. The link should follow the same active-route highlighting pattern used by the existing Gallery, Upload, and Dashboard nav links.

Register the new feed page route in App.tsx (TanStack Router) so that navigating to '/feed' renders the new FeedPage component. Ensure the route does not require authentication and does not conflict with existing routes.
